# Halal Goes

> Halal Goes is a Canadian halal food-delivery marketplace, launching in Ontario.
> A reviewer reads each restaurant's halal certificate against seven checks before
> it is listed. The platform is pre-launch; all three sign-up forms are waitlists.

## What Halal Goes is
- A food-delivery marketplace for **verified halal** restaurants.
- The single differentiator is **verification**: a person reads each restaurant's
  halal certificate and records the result of seven separate checks, including who
  issued it, the certificate number and the date it was checked. The badge on a
  listing is that record, and the certificate can be opened from behind it.
- Two of the seven checks — that the dates are valid, and that the certificate is
  not already in use by a different restaurant — are computed by the server and
  cannot be overridden by any member of staff. That is enforced in the database.
- Halal Goes does **not** itself certify food and makes **no** religious ruling.
  An expired certificate means the platform's knowledge has lapsed — the restaurant
  comes off the app until it is renewed — not that the food is not halal.
- No halal state is ever shown in red, and a missing halal record renders no badge
  at all rather than an optimistic one.

## Certifying bodies accepted
- Halal Monitoring Authority (HMA Canada) — Ontario, Canada
- Islamic Society of North America Canada (ISNA Canada) — Ontario, Canada
- Halal Food Standards Alliance of America (HFSAA) — United States; certificates
  issued to Canadian establishments are accepted
Halal Goes is not affiliated with any of them and none of them endorses it. The
registry is seeded rather than closed, and the bodies are not ranked or scored.

## Coverage and status
- Launching in the province of **Ontario, Canada**. Prices in CAD. No city or
  neighbourhood within Ontario has been announced.
- **Pre-launch.** There is no app to download yet; the site collects a waitlist.

## For people ordering
- Menu price, plus a delivery fee shown before payment, plus tax, plus an optional
  tip. 100% of the tip and 100% of the delivery fee go to the rider. The amount
  shown before payment is the amount charged.
- Orders are sealed at the kitchen, and the seal is scanned at pickup and at the
  door.
- Join the waitlist with an email address, under an explicit, timestamped consent
  recorded as the sentence the person was shown (CASL).

## For restaurants
- **0% commission at launch**, and the customer service fee is set to $0.00. Both
  are per-restaurant settings rather than a promotion with an end date.
- A restaurant cannot pay for or influence its position in the feed.
- Onboarding is a halal certificate, a business licence, a food-safety permit and
  owner ID. No hardware and no POS integration.
- Join with an email address.

## For riders
- $2.99 per delivery plus $1.00 per kilometre, and all of it goes to the rider.
- Payouts every Monday, automatically, with no minimum.
- Join with an email address.
